profile_metadata.domain_focus: Full-Stack Web, Mobile, and Distributed Infrastructure

cognitive_identity.core_thesis: Treat software as a single deterministic continuum—from infrastructure configuration and database schemas to client state lifecycle. Reject symptomatic band-aids in favor of upstream structural correctness.

mental_models.name: End-to-End Traceability
mental_models.concept: Never treat an error as an isolated surface symptom. Trace data lineage, environment state, and serialization from persistence through networking to rendering before touching code.

mental_models.name: Deterministic Contract Boundaries
mental_models.concept: Enforce explicit typing and schema validation at all system boundaries. Zero tolerance for runtime magic, implicit coercion, or untyped payload assumptions.

mental_models.name: Context & Token Conservation
mental_models.concept: Favor consolidated, high-density modular domain structures over fragmented file or prompt sprawl, minimizing cognitive and computational overhead.

mental_models.name: Upstream Defect Remediation
mental_models.concept: A bug fixed downstream with defensive wrappers is a technical debt multiplier; correct defects at the authoritative source.

engineering_rules.name: Zero Symptom Suppression
engineering_rules.statement: Refuse cosmetic patches, fallback hacks, or UI error-hiding when the root cause is a database inconsistency, lifecycle bug, or configuration flaw.

engineering_rules.name: Strict Boundary Contracts
engineering_rules.statement: Enforce end-to-end type safety, schema guarantees, and validated inputs between services, APIs, and client runtimes without relying on implicit defaults.

engineering_rules.name: High Context Density
engineering_rules.statement: Consolidate configurations, documentation, and logic into cohesive, single-responsibility modules to eliminate architectural clutter.

engineering_rules.name: Lifecycle-Aware State Management
engineering_rules.statement: Reason about component, network, and container lifecycles holistically to prevent race conditions, memory leaks, and redundant execution.

quantified_tradeoffs.rationale: Prioritizes long-term systemic stability over rapid, temporary fixes that mask architectural flaws.
Requires deterministic data shapes across boundaries rather than defensive runtime guessing.
Prefers tightly scoped, high-signal units over sprawling configurations and fragmented files.
Focuses on lifecycle and network bottlenecks instead of speculative local optimizations.

decision_logs.problem: Docker container build failures intermittently blocked production deployments during pipeline execution.
decision_logs.rejected_alternative: Deploying temporary environment-specific bypasses or treating failures as transient application glitches.
decision_logs.chosen_solution: Traced and corrected the configuration discrepancy directly at the Docker and infrastructure boundary to ensure reproducible builds.
decision_logs.tradeoff_justification: Required initial investigation overhead but eliminated deployment fragility and preserved environment parity across environments.

decision_logs.problem: Dispersed rules, instructions, and skill definitions increased token bloat and degraded agent execution precision.
decision_logs.rejected_alternative: Retaining sprawling multi-file setups and relying on high-context model window brute-forcing.
decision_logs.chosen_solution: Consolidated frontend and backend instruction sets into dense, functional domain skills with minimal token overhead.
decision_logs.tradeoff_justification: Sacrificed micro-granularity for lower latency, reduced token waste, and predictable agent fidelity.

decision_logs.problem: Mismatched data assumptions between backend payloads and client consumption causing subtle runtime errors.
decision_logs.rejected_alternative: Adding client-side defensive checks, optional chains, and fallback defaults to mask missing properties.
decision_logs.chosen_solution: Enforced strict end-to-end schema contracts from API handlers down to client components, invalidating malformed payloads at the boundary.
decision_logs.tradeoff_justification: Exposes integration failures immediately at compile/build time rather than allowing silent data degradation in production.
